title: Agent Message v1
description: Frozen execution contract (SW-1510-CONTRACT). Durable mailbox message between authenticated principals. sender_principal and recipient_principal must be bound by the server; a worker cannot choose an arbitrary reviewer identity. ack_state comes from the mailbox service, not the sender. The message is a durable, replayable record, not a fire-and-forget notification.

sender_principal.description: Authenticated sender identity bound by the mailbox server.

recipient_principal.description: Authenticated recipient identity. A worker cannot address an arbitrary reviewer identity.

ack_state.description: Acknowledgement state maintained by the mailbox service.
